body:
Now mechanism-complete: `ZMX_SESSION` gives a program its own name, so one command sets its state with no arguments, and every reader sees it in the same `zmx ls` parse.

What remains unverified is uptake rather than mechanism: whether the agents actually run here (pi in a jail, codex) can be made to emit blocked/working cheaply enough, and whether a stale value decays acceptably given no timestamps (q-state). Cheapest experiment: wrap one real workflow, see whether the label is fresh when it matters.
title: state= is the whole status channel
